createdBy: PR #7 (paymantorkiyan) — design and tests; deferred out of ISS-027 by plan
impact:
Since ISS-027 a request may name any repository via `cwd`, and its `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is read from THAT repository's root. But `.reviewbridge.json` is still loaded once at startup (src/server.ts:93) from the server's launch directory, and src/tools/review-precommit.ts:71 reads `review_standards.precommit.auto_diff` from that boot object regardless of `args.cwd`. The two repository-scoped inputs are now inconsistent: the reviewed repo's instructions apply, its config does not.

PR #7 solved this with `discoverProjectConfig(startDir)` — walk up to find `.reviewbridge.json`, `ok(null)` on a total miss — and a fall-back-to-BOOT-config-not-schema-defaults policy, so a user who set `precommit.auto_diff:false` via RB_CONFIG_PATH or $HOME is not silently reset to `true` when they pass a `cwd` whose tree has no config. Their test "no config found ANYWHERE up the tree preserves a non-default BOOT config value" pins that trap. Their `${path}:${mtimeMs}` warning memo is the necessary companion so per-call discovery does not re-warn about the same file every request.

Port plan against current code (do not copy verbatim — theirs is sync, unescaped, and climbs past the repo root):
- loader.ts: async `discoverProjectConfig(startDir, boundary)` using fs/promises; stop at our already-resolved `repositoryRoot` instead of probing for `.git`; when repositoryRoot is null, probe workingDirectory only, do not climb; keep our escapeTerminalControls on the warning path (theirs interpolates a caller-influenced path raw into console.error).
- request-prep.ts: let `prepareDiffReview` accept a source resolver `(w: ResolvedWorkspace) => Promise<Result<DiffSource>>`, evaluated after resolveWorkspace inside the permit — precommit currently decides the diff source BEFORE the workspace exists.
- review-precommit.ts and cli/commands.ts: a FIELD ALLOWLIST, never a config swap. ReviewBridgeConfigSchema carries `codex_path`, which names a binary to spawn; letting a hostile checkout's config become the process config is code execution. Read exactly one boolean: `discovered?.review_standards.precommit.auto_diff ?? boot`.

Decide explicitly before implementing: (1) precedence — at boot RB_CONFIG_PATH is a hard override, but per-call discovery would let a target repo override it; (2) the partial-config hole — a target config that omits `precommit.auto_diff` gets Zod's schema default `true`, silently discarding $HOME's `false` (PR #7 fixes the total-miss case but not this one).
title: Per-request .reviewbridge.json discovery: precommit auto_diff reads the server's boot config while instructions are read from the caller's repository
